body:
Welcome, adventurer!
You are about to enter a vast world full of secrets, unique Pokémon, and endless possibilities. Explore different regions, build your dream team, and experience an adventure like no other.

But your journey doesn’t end as a trainer:
 Create your own family,





![Baby](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/628fee0f125e0e99cae57515f2ee2259f3f3b28b.png)





 Build your own city or join others,





![House](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/41f6bfa33c71f01a2fbe3d4b0e1c6064760d65d0.png)





 Become a mechanic and construct powerful machines using Create that can change the world!





Whether you choose to be a trainer, builder, engineer, or leader — in Cobblemon Universal Adventure, you decide your path.
Have fun, good luck, and most importantly: enjoy your adventure!
